rule.statement: The investigation of the title must be preceded by a careful examination of the preliminary issue whether the land sought to be partitioned is commonly owned as required by section 2 (1) of the Partition Law.
rule.supporting_quote: It is imperative that the investigation of the title must be preceded by a careful examination of the preliminary issue whether the land sought to be partitioned is commonly owned as required by section 2 (1) of the Partition Law.
